name: AL Moasher Pay for Electronic Payment and Collection (S.A.E)
source: Starta Markets revenue and EPS plus AskBorsa gross profit and net profit, both compiled from EGX company disclosures, checked 15 Nov 2026

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys AMPI and AMPI.CA are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. The figure backed by the issuer's own filing () is served there; this key's conflicting figure is removed so one issuer does not carry two.

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys AMPI and AMPI.CA are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. The figure backed by the issuer's own filing () is served there; this key's conflicting figure is removed so one issuer does not carry two.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.derivedFrom: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys AMPI and AMPI.CA are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. The figure backed by the issuer's own filing () is served there; this key's conflicting figure is removed so one issuer does not carry two.

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys AMPI and AMPI.CA are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. The figure backed by the issuer's own filing () is served there; this key's conflicting figure is removed so one issuer does not carry two.

rows.label: Net Margin (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Margin (%) = Net Profit / Revenue x 100

note: Rebuilt 15 Nov 2026. Each year was accepted only where two independent compilers reproduced the same net profit within 1 percent (or 1,000 EGP) for that fiscal year, and revenue exceeded gross profit. Earlier Mubasher summary columns for this issuer did not reconcile with either compiler and were replaced. Cost of Sales is derived as Revenue minus Gross Profit.
